items.title: [Highlights] Trippy, videogame-esque "4D" render of a steal leading to a dunk by Raptors rookie Allen Graves (#19 overall pick) during SL (taken from the Raps' official FB page)
items.author: Robos_Basilisk
items.body_excerpt: Is this the first example of an NBA team using the AI-based 4D/3D Gaussian Splatting (4D/3DGS) rendering technology for a highlight? I know the NBA likes to explore cutting-edge technologies, but even I'm surprised they were already trialing it out during Summer League.
